scraped.scraped_description: Our users have registered more than 24,441,697 event participants

name: CiviCRM
tagline: Open source constituent relationship management for non-profits, NGOs and advocacy organizations
dependency_risks: depends on underlying CMS platforms (Drupal, WordPress, etc.)
news_articles: CiviCRM adoption by nonprofits and advocacy organizations (multiple outlets)
Open source CRM solutions for civil society organizations
academic_citations: Citations in nonprofit technology and open source governance literature
awards: Recognition as leading open source CRM for nonprofits

policy_outcomes.description: Processing of over 116 million donations and management of over 189 million contacts by organizations worldwide as of 2025
Registration of over 24 million event participants across user organizations

outcome_methodology: User-reported statistics and case studies from implementing organizations
documented_limitations: Dependency on underlying CMS platform stability
Limited built-in accessibility features in some modules
Scalability challenges for very large datasets
failure_modes: Data loss if underlying CMS platform fails
Performance degradation with very large contact databases
curation_criteria: Community-driven development; public issue tracker and RFC (Request for Comments) process for major features; Core Team review of contributions
contributor_governance: Community contributors with Core Team coordination; public issue tracker
government_partnerships: Partnerships with local government agencies and public sector organizations using CiviCRM for constituent management
ai_involvement: No significant AI/machine learning components; primarily traditional database and CRM functionality
